added_lines: a plaque to remember fr piert last sunday morning in st david’s church johnstown a plaque to remember fr piert was unveiled. below is a picture of the plaque with fr piert’s family. altar lists for the dead are available in the church please take one home. arklow

church notices weekend mass times: 6pm, 10.30am & 12 noon & barrowhouse sunday at 9 am . weekday masses: 9.30 am rosary at 9.10am world mission sunday collection takes place today at all masses, it replaces the usual share collection. it is one of three yearly universal church collections. world mission sunday collections take place in every single parish where the church is present. athy parish will have a speaker from the rosminians order on 7th/8th november . altar list of the dead sheets and envelopes are available at the doors of the church. mass on all souls day, 2nd november, and first friday masses during the year are offered for those whose names are on the altar list of the dead. you are invited to take a sheet and fill out the names of your loved ones who you wish to have remembered, when complete you may hand it into the office during office hours or put it into the collection baskets during masses. the new parish development year starts on 1st november. those who contribute annually are reminded that they can make their payment now. annual subscription envelopes can be put into the collection baskets during mass or handed into the office during office hours. area distributors are reminded boxes are now ready for collection from parish office during this week and will be behind the high altar from thursday next, 22nd oct. last weekend collections: p. dev. : € 770 common: €1,455 share: €900 thanks to all who contributed prayers for the dead
